run_mdr_phonon_benchmark: run a phonon benchmark calculation for an MDR PBE dataset point with structural relaxation and force constant computation
get_phonopy_object: create a Phonopy API object from ASE atoms or pymatgen Structure with supercell displacements
produce_force_constants: compute forces on displaced supercells and produce force constants using an ASE calculator
calculate_phonon_frequencies: calculate phonon frequencies at commensurate qpoints or a custom set of qpoints
calculate_thermal_properties: calculate vibrational free energy, entropy, and heat capacity across a temperature range using Fourier interpolation
